index.heading: Applications
index.lede: QS controllers run across multiple material families — metal, wood, stone, and jewellery — plus dedicated automation machines. Each group is its own machining challenge.

groups.name: Metal machining
groups.desc: QS Controller runs on CNC machines for metal machining, supporting operations such as milling, drilling, tapping and contour machining. The system suits a wide range of production needs, from molds and mechanical parts to industrial and medical device components. Precise motion control keeps the machine stable and matched to the machining requirements of each product.

groups.name: Wood machining
groups.desc: QS Controller runs on CNC machines for wood machining, covering operations such as jigsaw cutting, joinery and 2D, 3D carving. The system suits furniture production, woodcraft, decorative details and wooden components with complex contours. Precise motion control keeps cutting paths steady and faithful to the design contour.

groups.name: Stone machining
groups.desc: QS Controller runs on CNC machines for cutting and carving natural and engineered stone. The system supports patterns, reliefs, stone statues, countertops and decorative details with complex contours. Coordinated multi-axis motion keeps the machine on the toolpath and meets the shaping requirements of each product.

groups.name: Jewellery machining
groups.desc: QS Controller runs on CNC machines for jewellery machining, supporting engraving, milling and shaping of details on gold, silver and precious alloys. Precise motion control lets the machine handle intricate patterns, fine lines and surfaces that demand a high level of refinement. The system suits production of rings, bangles, pendants and many other jewellery products.

groups.name: Other automation
groups.desc: QS Controller runs on dedicated automation machines such as CNC glue dispensing machines, spring forming machines and many made-to-order production units. The system synchronises axis motion with the machine's I/O signals and actuators. Programmable customisation adapts flexibly to each process and equipment configuration.

detailPage.heroLede: CNC milling machines use rotating cutting tools to remove material from a workpiece — machining complex custom parts with high precision and high volume for moulds, mechanical components, and medical devices.
detailPage.productsLede: QS controller lines suited to automating this machine type. Pick a model by axis count, control mode, and the interfaces your machine needs.

workflow.d: NC files are loaded via USB, Ethernet, or DNC. The controller parses and simulates the toolpath on screen before the real run.
256-block look-ahead, S-curve acceleration, and tool-error compensation. The path is NURBS-smoothed for the best surface finish.
Pulse/encoder signals over 1 ms EtherCAT to the X/Y/Z axes and spindle inverter. The closed loop checks position every cycle.
The HMI shows coordinates, speed, spindle current, and alarms. Cycle data is logged for traceability and OEE.

detailPage.ctaBody: QS engineers help choose the I/O configuration, wiring diagram, and driver suited to this machine type.
